title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Receivables Standard — Crediting Payments and the Bank Card Surcharge
content:
## Clauses in force

**Crediting day.** A payment received on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account by the tier's cutoff time, Eastern Time, on a business day is credited that day, and otherwise on the next business day.

**Method.** The payment method must be one of the tier's accepted payment methods.

**Account status.** Payments are accepted on accounts whose status is active, on hold, closed or charged off. The status is read from the account record before the payment is taken; an account still in applied status, or one in declined status, takes no payment.

**Bank card surcharge.** A payment made with a third-party bank card incurs a surcharge of the tier's bank card surcharge percentage of the payment, rounded to the nearest cent, posted as a card payment surcharge fee referencing the first payment line. No surcharge is charged on a tier whose surcharge rate is 0.

| Case (hypothetical) | Tier surcharge | Payment | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank card payment, Commercial Account Net 30 | 2.50 percent | 1234.56 | 30.86 (2.50 percent of 1234.56 is 30.864, rounded to the cent) |
| Bank card payment, Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 2.00 percent | 1234.56 | 24.69 |
| Bank card payment, Pro Revolving Charge | 0.00 percent | 1234.56 | none |
| ACH payment, any tier | not applicable | 1234.56 | none |

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this standard are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current Ridgeline Pro Credit basis for payments:

- the clause that an owner, principal or authorized buyer of the business must authorize the debit before a phone payment is posted;
- the clause applying a payment first to the invoices named in the business's remittance, up to each invoice's open balance, then to the oldest past-due invoice and then to the oldest open invoice by invoice date, with any remainder held on account;
- the clause recording each invoice a payment touches as its own payment line under the same payment reference.

superseded_clauses: An owner, principal or authorized buyer of the business must authorize the debit before a phone payment is posted.

A payment is applied first to the invoices the business names in its remittance, up to each invoice's trade_msr_invoice_open_balance; any amount not directed by the remittance goes to the oldest past-due invoice first and then to the oldest open invoice by invoice_date; whatever remains after every open invoice is settled is held on account with an empty applied_invoice_number.
Each invoice the payment touches is recorded as its own trade_payment_received row under the same payment_reference.
